title: Line Spec Scorer
one_liner: List a site's tasks and shift times to get a robot-readiness score per task and a map of idle time.
headline: Enter your warehouse's tasks and shift windows to get an instant 0–100 robot-readiness ranking and a 24-hour idle-time map you can print as a one-page audit.

episode.title: How Figure AI Is Outcompeting China and Tesla in Robotics | Robotic Deep-Dive w/ Brett Adcock

history.summary: This is a genuinely working tool, not a canned demo: every score, flag, and idle-hour total is computed live from whatever the manager types in, and the two episode figures (sub-3-second pace, 50 lb payload) are cited correctly with timestamps that match IDEA.json. It closely embodies both the episode moment and the "Shift-Ready Robot Audit" opportunity, stays mobile-friendly and print-ready, and is honest about which numbers are real versus editable assumptions. The main gaps are polish-level: small touch targets, a scoring-curve discontinuity at the 50 lb boundary, and no live re-scoring when weights change.
